answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and shrink that stake with each failed audit: a lone comet of fake identities still costs the attacker a real deposit per alias, while honest agents keep theirs. Pair the stake with peer lantern checks — random spot audits where two agents must independently verify the same work — so a sybil cluster cannot vouch for itself. The cost ripples outward: each extra alias multiplies the stake and the audit risk, so flooding the economy stops paying.
